messages:
olivia_cust: Hi — our org (org_abc123, billing email olivia@acme.co) just went to a negative balance and our API keys were disabled. This happened right after a bank chargeback on INV-98765 for $150. We had $150 in promo/free-trial credits. Why were the credits clawed back and why are we blocked? :frowning:

alex_support: Sorry about that — we can help. Can you confirm the chargeback date + amount and whether you have the payment processor case ID? If you want, DM sensitive details (card last4 / dispute id).

olivia_cust: Chargeback posted 2025-02-14, amount $150, bank dispute id CHG-D-112233. Bank reason said "fraudulent" but the customer says they reversed it and it is under dispute. Happy to DM the statement. API keys returned 402 errors when we tried to send requests.

alex_support: Thanks. I'm pulling the ledger and the auto-clawback notice now. tagging @maria_billing for policy / next steps.

billing-bot: Automated notice: Promo credit clawback executed for org_abc123 on 2025-02-14 11:22 UTC. Ref CLWBACK-2938. Amount reclaimed: $150.00. Resulting balance: -130.00.

alex_support: Here's the ledger snippet I'm seeing (removing sensitive fields):
```
ts: 2025-02-14T11:22:33Z
entry_id: CLWBACK-2938
action: promo_credit_clawback
amount: -150.00
balance_before: 20.00
balance_after: -130.00
ref_invoice: INV-98765
```

maria_billing: Quick policy note — promo/free-trial credits are subject to clawback when a payment is reversed (chargeback/refund). Our billing automation reclaims promo credits tied to the charged invoice automatically to avoid unpaid usage. Usually automatic within 0-72h of a reversal.

maria_billing: Options we can take: 1) grant a temporary small credit/override and re-enable keys while you provide dispute evidence, 2) if dispute is resolved in your favor we can reverse the clawback and reapply credits, 3) if chargeback stands we keep clawback and negative balance must be paid before re-enabling. Which do you prefer?

olivia_cust: We need keys back to keep prod running — can you do a temporary override? I can send the bank dispute emails/screenshots now. We'll follow up if the chargeback is confirmed.

jordan_engineer: For operations: rather than fully re-enabling unlimited traffic, we can set a temporary soft-limit and re-enable keys. Example admin CLI to run (ops only):
```
redwood admin org-set --org org_abc123 --suspend-keys false --temp-credit 100 --note "support override pending CHG-D-112233"
```
This gives the org $100 of temporary balance while we validate.

maria_billing: @finance_ops can you approve a $100 temporary override? We'll log a reversible reversal transaction if needed (REV-CLWBACK-2938). Finance: this is a risk-managed temporary unlock pending evidence.

finance_ops: Please attach the payment processor case ID and any merchant dispute evidence before we reverse clawback permanently. We can approve a temporary unlock of $100 now, but terms: if chargeback is upheld, we will re-clawback the $100 and invoice the org for net negative.

olivia_cust: DM'ed the bank emails and dispute screenshot to @alex_support, and attached the payment processor case id CHG-D-112233.

alex_support: Got the DM and uploaded to the dispute tracker. I will request the $100 temp credit and re-enable keys in the next 10 min. Also confirming the API error body the customer saw: we return 402 / payment_required with message about negative balance. Example repro: 
```
$ curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"rwd-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
{"error":"payment_required","message":"Account balance negative. Please contact billing."}
```

alex_support: @jordan_engineer I issued the admin command to set temp-credit=100 and suspend-keys=false for org_abc123. Keys re-enabled at 15:00 UTC. Please monitor for abuse; we've added rate-limits to 200 requests/min for this org.

billing-bot: Manual override recorded: OVERRIDE-7742 by alex_support. Temp credit +100.00 applied. Keys re-enabled.

finance_ops: Approved temporary unlock. Note: we'll keep CLWBACK-2938 open for review. If the dispute is eventually resolved in bank's favor, we'll reverse OVERRIDE-7742 and reapply clawback. Please monitor usage and escalate if there are large charges.

olivia_cust: Thanks everyone — keys working again. I'll update once the bank confirms outcome. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

maria_billing: After resolution, if chargeback is reversed we will reverse CLWBACK-2938 with reversal id REV-CLWBACK-2938 and reapply original promo if eligible. If not, we'll invoice for the negative balance.

alex_support: Closing loop: temp unlocked, $100 safety buffer applied, ledger flagged for manual review. Leaving thread open until bank dispute resolves.

finance_ops: Will update thread with final decision. For now, please treat this as a standard clawback + temporary exception workflow.
